articles.title: The Kingmaker's Clock: Trump's Early Endorsements Reshape GOP Primaries
articles.summary: Trump is endorsing Republican candidates earlier than ever—averaging seven months before primaries in 2026, compared to seven weeks in 2018. This 'Complete and Total Endorsement' clears the field and gives his picks a massive advantage, though some still lose.

articles.title: A Second Chance at Risk: Supreme Court Ruling Threatens to Reimprison a Reformed Man
articles.summary: Anthony Bailey, 61, rebuilt his life after a judge freed him from a 27-year sentence. But a Supreme Court decision limiting 'compassionate release' could send him back to prison until 2050, reigniting debate over harsh mandatory sentences from the 1990s.

articles.title: Genetic Time Travel: DNA Links a Revolutionary War Soldier to His Modern Relatives
articles.summary: DNA analysis has identified Pvt. John Pumphrey, a Maryland teenager who died at the Battle of Camden in 1780. His remains, found in a shallow grave, connected to 20,000 living relatives, including Nancy White, who discovered a Revolutionary War hero in her Quaker ancestry.
